headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Zac Thornton earning the win. Marcus Semien led the Mets' offense with a home run and three RBIs. In other action, the Toronto Blue Jays edged the Philadelphia Phillies 5-4, with Josh Smith collecting 3 hits, including a home run, and driving in 1 run. The Oakland Athletics took down the Boston Red Sox 7-3, with several players making significant contributions to the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. The Seattle Mariners have placed Cole Wilcox on the 15-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins have placed Joe Ryan on the 15-day injured list with a left glute strain. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Cleveland Guardians, Chicago White Sox, Toronto Blue Jays, and Kansas City Royals.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place in the past 24 hours. The Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics received Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Zac Thornton earning the win. Marcus Semien led the Mets' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Phillies in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a hard-fought win over the Philadelphia Phillies, outlasting their opponents by a single run. Josh Smith led the Blue Jays' offense with a strong performance, collecting 3 hits, including a home run, and driving in 1 run.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 3-5 loss to the Washington Nationals, with Daylen Lile leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 3-2, securing a narrow victory. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Tyler Mahle pitched 6 strong innings with 9 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Ronald Acuña Jr. and Ben Rice led the Braves' offense, while Chris Sale and Gerrit Cole had strong performances on the mound.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with several players making significant contributions to the win. Impact hitters for the Athletics included Henry Bolte, Jacob Wilson, Tyler Soderstrom, Jahmai Jones, and Nick Sogard, while Gage Jump stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Ben Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's status will be reassessed after the 10-day period.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as the team looks to make a push in the second half of the season.
